An accessible combobox built on Downshift, with async loading, multi-select and keyboard navigation.

Mirrored from [downshift-shadcn-combobox](https://github.com/OmerMakesStuff/downshift-shadcn-combobox) by OmerMakesStuff, MIT licensed.
Source is copied verbatim from the project's own registry — the same code you would get

